evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: This story does not require a missing complementary capability elsewhere in the backlog; search/discovery can be implemented from indexed content (uploads exist).

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Personalized search relies on user profile data; no complementary capability is missing from the backlog that would prevent implementation.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Collaborative filtering can be built from user interaction data; the backlog contains related user-focused features and no complementary capability is evidently missing.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video
evaluations.rationale: Similarity-based search does not expose a missing complementary capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Uses enriched metadata/tags; backlog includes upload of tagged videos (ZO-006), so complementary capability exists.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: This story provides the creation/upload capability (tags) required by many processing stories, so it does not expose a completeness gap.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Thumbnail/segment viewing assumes segmentation exists; the backlog contains segmentation-related stories (e.g., ZO-019, ZO-032, ZO-036) that provide complementary capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Similarity/info features rely on indexing and detection stories present elsewhere; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity can be derived from automated analysis stories; the backlog includes many detection/preclassification capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation based on profiles is supported by profile/search stories (ZO-002) and does not expose a missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Event-based recommendation can be built from available metadata and news-detection features; no complementary capability is evidently missing.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product recognition and enrichment can be implemented from indexing and external data; no complementary backlog item is missing.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
